description: This file defines the interface EncounterVisitHandler, which specifies the contract for handling how encounters are assigned to visits in the OpenMRS system. It includes methods for displaying handler names and for deciding whether an encounter should be associated with an existing visit or a new one.

classes.name: EncounterVisitHandler
classes.description: An interface defining the methods necessary for different strategies to determine if an encounter should be part of an active visit and how to assign it.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for the handler, optionally localized.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for the handler based on the provided locale.

methods.name: beforeCreateEncounter
methods.description: Decides whether and how to assign the encounter to a visit before the encounter is created, updating the encounter with visit information.
